data_quality.check: Every order has at least one line (order_count is derived from lines)
Processed refunds never exceed the refunded line's revenue
No refund is dated before its order
No order falls outside the documented coverage window 2026-01-01..2026-06-30
Refund rows always reference a line of the same order (composite FK)

golden_queries.question: What was net revenue by month in the first half of 2026?
golden_queries.sql:
WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_TS, o.REGION_CODE, o.CHANNEL_CODE
    FROM METRICGUARD.ORDERS o
    WHERE o.STATUS IN (CAST(? AS VARCHAR(16)))
      AND o.ORDER_TS >= CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND o.ORDER_TS < CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
),
line_refunds AS (
    -- Pre-aggregate refunds per order line BEFORE joining (no fan-out).
    SELECT r.ORDER_ITEM_ID, SUM(r.REFUND_AMOUNT) AS REFUND_AMOUNT
    FROM METRICGUARD.REFUNDS r
    JOIN eligible_orders e ON e.ORDER_ID = r.ORDER_ID
    WHERE r.STATUS = CAST(? AS VARCHAR(12))
    GROUP BY r.ORDER_ITEM_ID
),
line_facts AS (
    SELECT e.ORDER_ID, e.ORDER_TS, e.REGION_CODE, e.CHANNEL_CODE, p.CATEGORY,
           (i.QUANTITY * i.UNIT_PRICE) - i.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT AS LINE_REVENUE,
           COALESCE(lr.REFUND_AMOUNT, 0) AS LINE_REFUND
    FROM eligible_orders e
    JOIN METRICGUARD.ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = e.ORDER_ID
    JOIN METRICGUARD.PRODUCTS p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID
    LEFT JOIN line_refunds lr ON lr.ORDER_ITEM_ID = i.ORDER_ITEM_ID
)
SELECT VARCHAR_FORMAT(f.ORDER_TS, 'YYYY-MM') AS ORDER_MONTH,
       CAST(COALESCE(SUM(f.LINE_REVENUE), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(f.LINE_REFUND), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NET_REVENUE
FROM line_facts f
GROUP BY VARCHAR_FORMAT(f.ORDER_TS, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY ORDER_MONTH ASC
FETCH FIRST 501 ROWS ONLY

golden_queries.question: Compare gross revenue, refund amount and refund rate by region for Q1 2026.
golden_queries.sql:

    SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_TS, o.REGION_CODE, o.CHANNEL_CODE
    FROM METRICGUARD.ORDERS o
    WHERE o.STATUS IN (CAST(? AS VARCHAR(16)))
      AND o.ORDER_TS >= CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)

),
line_refunds AS (
    -- Pre-aggregate refunds per order line BEFORE joining (no fan-out).
    SELECT r.ORDER_ITEM_ID, SUM(r.REFUND_AMOUNT) AS REFUND_AMOUNT
    FROM METRICGUARD.REFUNDS r
    JOIN eligible_orders e ON e.ORDER_ID = r.ORDER_ID
    WHERE r.STATUS = CAST(? AS VARCHAR(12))
    GROUP BY r.ORDER_ITEM_ID
),
line_facts AS (
    SELECT e.ORDER_ID, e.ORDER_TS, e.REGION_CODE, e.CHANNEL_CODE, p.CATEGORY,
           (i.QUANTITY * i.UNIT_PRICE) - i.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT AS LINE_REVENUE,
           COALESCE(lr.REFUND_AMOUNT, 0) AS LINE_REFUND
    FROM eligible_orders e
    JOIN METRICGUARD.ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = e.ORDER_ID
    JOIN METRICGUARD.PRODUCTS p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID
    LEFT JOIN line_refunds lr ON lr.ORDER_ITEM_ID = i.ORDER_ITEM_ID
)
SELECT f.REGION_CODE AS REGION,
       CAST(COALESCE(SUM(f.LINE_REVENUE), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS GROSS_REVENUE,
       CAST(COALESCE(SUM(f.LINE_REFUND), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS REFUND_AMOUNT,
       CAST(ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(f.LINE_REFUND), 0) AS DECIMAL(25,4)) / NULLIF(SUM(f.LINE_REVENUE), 0), 6) AS DECIMAL(12,6)) AS REFUND_RATE
FROM line_facts f
GROUP BY f.REGION_CODE
ORDER BY REGION ASC

golden_queries.question: What was the average order value and order count by sales channel in Q2 2026?
golden_queries.sql:
WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_TS, o.REGION_CODE, o.CHANNEL_CODE
    FROM METRICGUARD.ORDERS o
    WHERE o.STATUS IN (CAST(? AS VARCHAR(16)))
      AND o.ORDER_TS >= CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND o.ORDER_TS < CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
),
line_facts AS (
    SELECT e.ORDER_ID, e.ORDER_TS, e.REGION_CODE, e.CHANNEL_CODE, p.CATEGORY,
           (i.QUANTITY * i.UNIT_PRICE) - i.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT AS LINE_REVENUE,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS LINE_REFUND
    FROM eligible_orders e
    JOIN METRICGUARD.ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = e.ORDER_ID
    JOIN METRICGUARD.PRODUCTS p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID
)
SELECT f.CHANNEL_CODE AS CHANNEL,
       CAST(ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.LINE_REVENUE) AS DECIMAL(25,4)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.ORDER_ID), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AVERAGE_ORDER_VALUE,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT
FROM line_facts f
GROUP BY f.CHANNEL_CODE
ORDER BY CHANNEL ASC
FETCH FIRST 501 ROWS ONLY

traps.title: Refunds joined to items at order grain (fan-out)
traps.naive_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(i.QUANTITY * i.UNIT_PRICE - i.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) FROM METRICGUARD.ORDERS o JOIN METRICGUARD.ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN METRICGUARD.REFUNDS r ON r.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE o.STATUS = 'COMPLETED'

traps.title: Net revenue ignoring order status and refund status
traps.naive_sql: SELECT CAST((SELECT SUM(QUANTITY * UNIT_PRICE - DISCOUNT_AMOUNT) FROM METRICGUARD.ORDER_ITEMS) - (SELECT SUM(REFUND_AMOUNT) FROM METRICGUARD.REFUNDS) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1

traps.title: Revenue including shipping summed after a line join
traps.naive_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(i.QUANTITY * i.UNIT_PRICE - i.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT + o.SHIPPING_AMOUNT) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) FROM METRICGUARD.ORDERS o JOIN METRICGUARD.ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE o.STATUS = 'COMPLETED'

traps.title: January order count with BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' (drops Jan 31 after midnight)
traps.naive_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM METRICGUARD.ORDERS WHERE STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ORDER_TS BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31'
